author: Ross M.
review: I am delighted with my purchase! I ordered the lamp and candle holders for a Christmas present on a Monday and they were delivered to me on the following Wednesday. I had a slight problem with the electrical cord, however, the problem was fixed that same evening. I couldn't be happier with the product or the service!
headline: Delivered in 2 days — problem fixed the same evening. 5 stars!

author: Ann B.
review: Thank you for the prompt delivery of my order — I am very impressed with your service. I was given a Salty candle lamp and I love it.
headline: Very impressed with the service.

author: Simon D.
review: Thank you so much for my Rock salt lamp & candle holders and also the bath salts and culinary salts, very professional company practice indeed, contacted me to tell me the order had been dispatched and also the delivery company. Excellent service time after time. Have been recommending you to all my patients. Thank you and keep up the good work.
headline: Recommending to all my patients — excellent service time after time.
note: Likely a healthcare professional. Strong implicit endorsement for health/wellness positioning.

author: Umm Hajar
review: Its a blessing to have a company such as Salty Lamps as nowadays it is hard to find good products for good value for money at the same time. I have converted all my family to replacing their table salt to the culinary himalayan salt, especially my mother who has high blood pressure. I'm very pleased with your products and especially the quick delivery service.
headline: Converted the whole family — especially great for my mother with high blood pressure.
note: Directly references health benefit of culinary salt for blood pressure. Key testimonial for the health content strategy.

author: Julie D.
review: My sister gave me a salty lamp for Christmas years ago and I have since bought quite a few. I absolutely love sitting with the nice orange glow and the first thing I do when I get in at night is switch on my salty lamps! I might consider buying one for my office!
headline: The first thing I do when I get home is switch on my salty lamps.
note: Gifting and repeat purchase in one review. Mentions office use — small B2B signal.
